topic: Adopting a Cat at the Animal Shelter

script.title: MEETING MOCHI
script.scene_zh: 收容所 · 貓咪見面室
script.story_hook: She has been waiting for a person like you.
script.intro_zh: 她一直在等一個像你這樣的人。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to the shelter visiting room. Listen for easy words about adopting a cat.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎來到收容所的貓咪見面室。留意收養貓咪的簡單說法。
script.outro: That's one cat with a plan now. Listen again and say it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 一隻貓咪就這樣有了新家計畫。再聽一次，大聲跟著說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now it's time to repeat after us.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在輪到跟讀，一句一句跟著唸。
script.char_a_description: a stocky man in his early thirties with soft wavy chestnut hair falling over one eyebrow, a scruffy goatee, a rust orange corduroy jacket over a plain grey tee, and canvas sneakers
script.char_b_description: a petite young woman in her twenties with bright pink hair tied in a high ponytail, a tiny whisker tattoo on her cheek, a lavender volunteer t-shirt, a lanyard badge, and a warm smile

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, are these the friendly cat people?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ɑr ðiz ðə ˈfrendli ˈkæt ˈpipəl/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，請問這裡就是那群超友善的貓咪志工嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are, and yes, today they're extra friendly.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈɑr ænd ˈjɛs təˈdeɪ ðeɪ ˈɛkstrə ˈfrɛndli/
dialogue.zh: 是的，而且今天牠們格外友善。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's hopeful. Um, I mostly came to meet a cat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈhoʊpfəl ˈʌm aɪ ˈmoʊstli ˈkeɪm tə ˈmit ə ˈkæt/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來有希望。嗯，我主要是來見見貓的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right this way, they're behind door number four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt ðɪs ˈweɪ ðeɪr bɪˈhaɪnd ˈdɔɹ ˈnʌmbɚ ˈfɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 這邊請，貓咪們都在四號門後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh my. This gray one just walked to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ maɪ ðɪs ˈɡɹeɪ wʌn dʒʌst ˈwɔkt tə mi/
dialogue.zh: 天呀。這隻灰色的自己走過來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's Mochi, she chose you, that's her thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈmoʊtʃi ʃi ˈtʃoz ju ðæts ˈhɚ θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 她是 Mochi，她選了你，這是她的招牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chose? Haha, okay, I'm honored, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃoʊz hɑˈhɑ oʊˈkeɪ aɪm ˈɑnɚd ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 挑我？哈哈，好榮幸，真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She does that to the nice ones every time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi dʌz ðæt tə ðə ˈnaɪs wʌnz ˈɛvri ˈtaɪm/
dialogue.zh: 她每次都會精準挑中溫柔的那種人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I sit down while she looks me over?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ˈsɪt ˈdaʊn ˈwaɪl ʃi lʊks mi ˈoʊvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 她打量我的時候，我可以先坐下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, the benches are right along the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliːz du ðə ˈbɛntʃəz ɑr ˈɹaɪt əˈlɔŋ ðə ˈwɔl/
dialogue.zh: 請坐，長凳就沿著牆放一排。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, she's on my lap now, um, wow.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ʃiz ɑn maɪ ˈlæp ˈnaʊ ʌm ˈwaʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好，她跳上我的腿了，嗯，哇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's a yes from her, just so you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə ˈjɛs fɹəm hɜ dʒʌst ˈsoʊ ju ˈnoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 她這算是點頭答應了，先讓你知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, all right. So, tell me about adopting her.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɔlˈɹaɪt soʊ ˈtɛl mi əˈbaʊt əˈdɑptɪŋ hɜ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，好，那來說說收養她的流程吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First, a quick form, then a short chat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɝst ə kwɪk ˈfɔɹm ðɛn ə ʃɔɹt ˈtʃæt/
dialogue.zh: 先填一張短表，然後簡單聊一聊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Um, how long has she been here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi ɪˈnʌf ˈʌm haʊ ˈlɔŋ hæz ʃi bɪn hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 不難。嗯，她來到這裡多久了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four months, found sleeping under a parked car.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ mʌnθs ˈfaʊnd ˈslipɪŋ ˈʌndɚ ə ˈpɑɹkt ˈkɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 四個月了，找到時她正睡在一輛車底下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Poor thing, who feeds all you cats here?
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊɹ θɪŋ hu fiz ɔl ju ˈkæts hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 可憐的，這邊這麼多貓，平常誰餵？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly volunteers, mornings and evenings daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊstli ˌvolənˈtɪrz ˈmɔɹnɪŋz ænd ˈivnɪŋz ˈdeɪli/
dialogue.zh: 多數是志工，每天早晚各餵一輪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, she deserves good people feeding her.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ʃɪ dɪˈzɝvz ɡʊd ˈpipəl ˈfidɪŋ hɜ/
dialogue.zh: 真好，她值得讓人好好餵飽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, any questions about the adoption fee?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈɛni ˈkwɛstʃənz əˈbaʊt ði əˈdɑpʃən ˈfi/
dialogue.zh: 那麼，關於收養費用有什麼問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just one, um, what does that fee include?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst wʌn ʌm wʌt dʌz ðæt ˈfi ɪnˈklud/
dialogue.zh: 就一個，嗯，那個費用包含什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's seventy-five: shots, microchip, surgery, done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˌsɛvənti ˈfaɪv ʃɑts ˈmaɪkɹoʊˌtʃɪp ˈsɝdʒəɹi dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 費用是七十五塊：疫苗、識別晶片、絕育手術，全都完成了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Surgery already? Okay, that saves me errands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɝdʒəɹi ɔlˈɹɛdi oʊˈkeɪ ðæt ˈseɪvz mi ˈɛɹəndz/
dialogue.zh: 手術已經做過了？好，那我少跑幾趟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, the vet covered the first set of shots.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðə ˈvɛt ˈkʌvərd ðə ˈfɝst sɛt əv ʃɑts/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，合作獸醫也把第一輪疫苗打齊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the seventy-five, is that a card thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈsɛvənti faɪv ɪz ðæt ə ˈkɑɹd θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那七十五塊，可以刷卡繳嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cards are great, we also take online payment.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑɹdz ɑr ˈɡɹeɪt wi ˈɔlsoʊ ˈteɪk ˌɑnˈlaɪn ˈpeɪmənt/
dialogue.zh: 刷卡沒問題，線上繳款我們也收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, my wallet lives in my phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt maɪ ˈwɑlɪt ˈlɪvz ɪn maɪ ˈfoʊn/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我的錢包就住在手機裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Understood, nobody carries cash these days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndəˈstʊd ˈnoʊbədi ˈkæɹiz ˈkæʃ ðiz ˈdeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我懂，現在也沒幾個人帶現金了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, how soon could Mochi come home with me?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ haʊ ˈsun kʊd ˈmoʊtʃi ˈkʌm hoʊm wɪð mi/
dialogue.zh: 那 Mochi 多快能跟我一起回家？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually one week, there's a home check first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒəwəli wʌn ˈwik ðɛɹz ə ˈhoʊm ˈtʃɛk ˈfɝst/
dialogue.zh: 通常要一週，因為要先做一次居家拜訪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A visit to my place? Um, my home's tiny.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈvɪzɪt tə maɪ ˈpleɪs ʌm maɪ ˈhoʊmz ˈtaɪni/
dialogue.zh: 要到我家裡來拜訪？嗯，我家小小的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tiny is fine, cats measure hearts, not rooms.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaɪni ɪz ˈfaɪn ˈkæts ˈmɛʒɚ ˈhɑɹts ˈnɑt ˈrumz/
dialogue.zh: 小沒關係，貓看的是心意，不是房間大小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Haha, that's the nicest thing I've heard today.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑˈhɑ ðæts ðə ˈnaɪsəst θɪŋ aɪv hɝd təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，這是我今天聽過最暖的一句話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We mean it, so what's your name on the form?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈmin ɪt soʊ wʌts jɔɹ ˈneɪm ɑn ðə ˈfɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 我們是認真的。來，表格上的名字是？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Liam Ortega, that's L-I-A-M, no H.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈliəm ɔɹˈteɪɡə ðæts ˈɛl aɪ ˈeɪ ˈɛm noʊ ˈeɪtʃ/
dialogue.zh: Liam Ortega，名字拼法是 L-I-A-M，沒有 H。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Liam, got it. Do you have other animals?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈliəm ˈɡɑɾ ɪt du ju ˈhæv ˈʌðəɹ ˈænɪməlz/
dialogue.zh: Liam，記下了。你家還有其他動物嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, just me, um, will Mochi be lonely?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ dʒʌst mi ʌm wɪl ˈmoʊtʃi bi ˈloʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 沒有，就我一個，嗯，Mochi 會不會孤單？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She'll nap sixteen hours a day, promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃil næp ˌsɪksˈtin ˈaʊɚz ə ˈdeɪ ˈpɹɑmɪs/
dialogue.zh: 她一天要睡十六個小時，放心吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold. Now, does the home check take long?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊld naʊ dʌz ðə ˈhoʊm ˈtʃɛk ˈteɪk ˈlɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 成交。那居家拜訪會花很久嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes, we peek, ask, then leave.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnəts wi ˈpik æsk ðɛn ˈliv/
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘就好，我們看看、問問，然後離開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you check my windows and balcony?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju ˈtʃɛk maɪ ˈwɪndoʊz ænd ˈbælənsi/
dialogue.zh: 你們會檢查我的窗戶和陽台嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, screens on windows keep cats safe, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈskrinz ɑn ˈwɪndoʊz ˈkip ˈkæts ˈseɪf ˈɔlweɪz/
dialogue.zh: 會的，窗紗能保護貓，這個最重要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine are solid, I checked them last month.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪnz ɑr ˈsɑɪd aɪ ˈtʃɛkt ðɛm læst ˈmʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 我的窗紗很牢固，上個月才檢查過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, you're already thinking like a cat person.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɹeɪt jʊɹ ɔlˈɹɛdi ˈθɪŋkɪŋ laɪk ə ˈkæt ˈpɝsən/
dialogue.zh: 很好，你已經很有貓奴思維了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, what should I buy before pickup day?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wʌt ˈʃʊd aɪ ˈbaɪ bɪˈfɔɹ ˈpɪkup ˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那接她回家之前，我該先買些什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Litter box, food, one bowl, and a carrier.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪɾɚ ˈbɑks ˈfud wʌn ˈboʊl ænd ə ˈkæɹiɚ/
dialogue.zh: 貓砂盆、飼料、一個碗，還有一個外出籠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The carrier, um, mine is still in a box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkæɹiɚ ˈʌm maɪn ɪz ˈstɪl ɪn ə ˈbɑks/
dialogue.zh: 外出籠的話，嗯，我那一個還在紙箱裡沒拆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then buy a big one, she'll grow into it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈbaɪ ə ˈbɪɡ wʌn ʃil ˈɡɹoʊ ˈɪntə ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那就買個大的，她長大一點也裝得下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smart. Food here, or the store down the street?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt ˈfud hɪɹ ɔɹ ðə ˈstɔɹ daʊn ðə ˈstɹit/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。飼料在這裡買，還是去街那頭的店？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with our bag, switching takes one week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstɑɹt wɪθ ˈaʊɚ ˈbæɡ ˈswɪtʃɪŋ ˈteɪks wʌn ˈwik/
dialogue.zh: 先拿我們這包開始，換別牌飼料要花一週慢慢改。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted, slow swap, got it. What about toys?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtɪd ˈsloʊ ˈswɑp ˈɡɑɾ ɪt wʌt əˈbaʊt ˈtɔɪz/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，慢慢換。那玩具呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A feather wand beats all the fancy pet store toys.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈfɛðɚ ˈwænd bits ɔl ðə ˈfænsi pɛt stɔɹ ˈtɔɪz/
dialogue.zh: 一根羽毛逗貓棒，贏過寵物店所有花俏玩具。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, noted twice. Can I visit her again Friday?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈnoʊtɪd twaɪs kæn aɪ ˈvɪzɪt hɚ əˈɡɛn ˈfɹaɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，兩點都記下了。我週五能再來看她嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, five to seven, come say hi, no forms.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs faɪv tə ˈsɛvən kʌm ˈseɪ ˈhaɪ noʊ ˈfɔɹmz/
dialogue.zh: 可以，五點到七點，來打個招呼，不用填表。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I'll bring Mochi a little treat, um, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪl brɪŋ ˈmoʊtʃi ə ˈlɪɾəl ˈtɹit ʌm oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那我可以帶點小點心給她，嗯，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask first, some cats eat treats too fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ˈfɝst sʌm ˈkæts it ˈtɹits tu ˈfæst/
dialogue.zh: 先問一聲，有些貓吃零食太快會不舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair, I'll ask the staff before I open it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɛɹ aɪl æsk ðə ˈstæf bɪˈfɔɹ aɪ ˈoʊpən ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 合理，打開之前我會先問工作人員。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're careful, Mochi picked a good human.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈkɛɹfəl ˈmoʊtʃi ˈpɪkt ə ˈɡʊd ˈhjumən/
dialogue.zh: 你真細心，Mochi 挑人的眼光果然好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday at five, and thanks for this start.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɹaɪdeɪ æt ˈfaɪv ænd ˈθæŋks ˈfɔɹ ðɪs ˈstɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 週五五點見，謝謝你給了這麼好的開頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, she'll purr the whole drive home.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ʃil pɜr ðə ˈhoʊl ˈdɹaɪv hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 該謝的是你，她會一路咕嚕咕嚕坐車回家。

script.youtube_title: 【收貓之家🐱】「她選了你」🐾🥺｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜聽完就敢去收容所領養｜Adopting a Cat at a Shelter
script.youtube_title_en: "She Chose You" — Adopting a Cat at the Animal Shelter
script.youtube_description:
「她選了你」——在動物收容所收養一隻貓，從見面到帶回家要問清楚哪些事？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在收容所的貓咪見面室。

你會聽到：走進見面室開場、貓咪自己跳上腿時的可愛插曲；填表與簡短面談的實用句；收養費用怎麼問，疫苗、晶片、絕育全包怎麼說；刷卡與線上繳款；居家拜訪會不會嫌房子小；還有一週後接貓前要準備貓砂盆、外出籠、慢慢換飼料與羽毛逗貓棒的溫馨建議。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，充滿美國人日常說話的語感：um、ha、haha、wow、sold。聽完你就會用：Tell me about adopting her、What does that fee include、How soon could Mochi come home、I'll bring Mochi a little treat。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓耳朵先熟，嘴巴自然跟上。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

"She chose you" — what do you actually ask when adopting a cat at an animal shelter? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set inside the shelter's visiting room.

You will hear: meeting a cat who picks her own person, the quick form and short chat, what the adoption fee covers (shots, microchip, surgery), card and online payment, the home check for a tiny apartment, window screens, a slow food switch, and a feather wand over all the fancy pet store toys.

Everything stays A2-level with natural speech: um, ha, haha, wow, sold. By the end you'll own lines like Tell me about adopting her, What does that fee include, and How soon could Mochi come home.

The final chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

📌 影片簡介：
想去收容所看貓，卻怕一開口就卡住？收養費用到底包含什麼？房子小小的一間，收養會卡關嗎？接貓之前該先準備哪些東西？

這一集帶大家走進收容所的貓咪見面室，從一隻自己走過來的貓開始，一路聽到填表、面談、繳費、居家拜訪與接貓清單，共 60 句連續真實對話。

🎒 接貓準備：So, what should I buy before pickup day?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、haha、sold 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧
